---
title: "Economic Connectedness"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(primer.data)
library(scales)  # For better axis formatting
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
ggplot(economics, aes(x = psavert)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "darkgreen", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of Personal Savings Rate",
    x = "Personal Savings Rate (%)",
    y = "Number of Months"
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
ggplot(connectedness, aes(x = population, y = connectedness)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "#2c7fb8", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE) +  # Line of best fit
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "County Connectedness by Population",
       subtitle = "Larger populations tend to have higher connectedness scores",
       x = "Population (log scale)",
       y = "Connectedness Score",
       caption = "Data from tidyverse dataset") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

```
